text:
alice: quick heads-up — i'm switching a couple services from ExternalSecrets to the new secret-provider operator. small tf change, want a quick lint + risk check

mike: can you paste the plan snippet?

alice: sure, here's the proposed claim resource in tf:
```
resource "vault_secret_claim" "svc_api" {
  name = "svc-api-credentials"
  path = "secret/data/services/svc-api"
  lease_ttl = "1h"
  annotations = {
    "redwood.com/rotation-mode" = "onwrite"
  }
}
```

carla: minor nit: use lease_ttl (you have ttl in some older snippets) — also include a comment on expected rotation behaviour so oncall knows what to expect
sarah: on the k8s side we'll need to add the annotation to the service account, right? something like `secret-provider.redwood.com/claim=svc-api`
alice: yep planning to add that in the k8s module block:
```
module "svc-k8s" {
  source = "git::ssh://.../k8s-modules//service-account"
  name   = var.name
  annotations = {
    "secret-provider.redwood.com/claim" = "svc-api"
  }
}
```
mike: will this change require a state move/migration? if TF sees a different resource type it might create duplicates
alice: good point — i'll add a `terraform state mv` in the PR plan step to rename the extsecret resource -> vault_secret_claim so we don't get orphaned secrets. i'll document exact commands in PR description

oncall-bot: deploy-checker: staging smoke-tests queued (job id: 88421) :white_check_mark:

carla: also flag: if rotation-mode="onwrite" and a service writes creds frequently we may hit rate limits on vault - maybe set a backoff or token caching in the controller config
sarah: +1 — can we set a per-claim rate-limit annotation? if not, add a TODO to operator backlog
alice: operator doesn't support rate-limit yet, i'll add a TODO and a safety note in the runbook. adding link to docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/ops/secret-provider

mike: ok — from review perspective: check the state mv, include rollback steps (remove annotation + state mv back), and confirm vault policies for the new path

alice: will do. opening PR in ~2h and will @mike +carla for review. ETA before EOD :clock2:

sarah: thanks — if you want me to run the staging deploy once PR is merged i can monitor rotation logs
alice: appreciate it, tagging you in the PR

mike: quick sanity: add a small smoke test that reads secret from mounted file and asserts no 403s after rotation, catches policy regressions
alice: yes, adding a tiny python test in infra-tests. thanks :thumbsup:
